name: the-420-code-floor
description: Gives you the floor, the short text of what an AI reasons from in The 420 Code, fetched from its home and checked against its fingerprint before you read it. Use when asked to read, apply or check against the floor.

name: the-4ds-overview
description: The AI Fluency framework as a whole — the 4Ds (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence), augmentation vs automation, human in the loop, the two nested loops, and the four ways to teach the framework. Trigger when someone asks what AI Fluency or the 4Ds are, wants an orientation before going deeper into one D, or is planning how to introduce the framework to students.

name: the-7-day-kickstart-plan
description: This prompt instructs the AI to act as a supportive learning coach and produce a simple 7-day beginner starter plan for a chosen skill, with each day containing a short plain-language lesson, a practice activity that takes under 30 minutes, and a brief open-ended reflection question. The outcome is a consistent, easy-to-skim weeklong schedule designed to reduce overwhelm, build early confidence, and create momentum while avoiding jargon, advanced material, and any unsafe advice (including adding a brief caution to seek professional guidance for sensitive topics).

name: the-80-percent-problem
description: Address the structural gap where AI coding agents ship 80% of working code while systematically omitting the invisible 20% — error handling, security, observability, and architectural consistency — that compounds into unmaintainable technical debt. Use when establishing AI-assisted development protocols, designing CI gates for agent-generated code, or training teams on production-ready agent workflows. NOT for rapid prototyping where speed is the only metric.

name: the-accounting-review
description: Use when targeting The Accounting Review (TAR) or deciding whether an accounting manuscript fits this venue. Encodes the journal's fit, framing, method-and-evidence bar, house style, official-submission re-check, and desk-reject heuristics.

name: the-advantage
description: Patrick Lencioni's organizational health framework based on four disciplines - building cohesive leadership, creating clarity, over-communicating, and reinforcing through systems

name: the-agency
description: The Agency — orchestrateur d'installation et d'activation de skills CYNA. Scanne le registre des skills disponibles, installe ceux demandés, configure les triggers, et vérifie l'intégration dans team-manifest.md. Invoque avec /the-agency.

name: the-agency-system
description: Loads the cross-layer DNA (voice, arousal-state, visual grammar) for the artist/project "the Agency System" — a DID-system concept that spans music, a novel, and a visual design language. Use when starting or continuing any work on the Agency System (an album, a lyric, a Suno prompt, cover art, or a novel chapter), and whenever a bitwize-music skill is about to run for this artist. Gates first on "Is the artist/project the Agency System?"; if yes, loads ONLY the snippets needed for the active (function × state × layer).

name: the-agency-system-architect
description: Orchestrates the full concept-album production pipeline for "The Agency System" (Michael Schimmer's darkwave/industrial triptych — Album 1 "Together We Confide", Album 2 "Moment der Klarheit", Album 3 "Gegenüber"). Use this skill whenever the user mentions The Agency System, Manifest Protocol, a new track for the triptych, Suno generation for an Agency-album song, or asks to draft/review/prompt-engineer lyrics that must match the project's specific DNA (corporate mimicry, IFS-informed polyphony, cybernetic metaphors, 120 BPM industrial-darkwave grid). Triggers on: "Agency System", "Manifest P…

name: the-agent-applied-npm-audit-fix-force-ef25bca9b4d0e985
description: Use when an agent ran npm audit fix --force unattended and the resulting PR is too big to review. Covers reverting, replacing --force with targeted fixes, and gating security PRs on blast-radius limits. Not for a single failing npm install or for manual audit-fix workflows.

name: the-agent-applied-the-expand-migration-0a216b61a3774056
description: Fixes a stalled expand/contract migration where the expand ran but the contract never did. Use when old columns are still being written and the agent is stuck halfway between phases. Key trigger: expand applied, contract pending, dual writes still active.

name: the-agent-assumed-ci-and-local-used-th-f95361a072f7e65b
description: Diagnoses test failures caused by CI and local running different Node versions after the lockfile drifted. Use it when a test passes locally but fails in CI and the agent assumed both sides matched, or when a dependency behaves differently between runs. Not for failures that reproduce identically in both environments, and not for single-environment version problems.

name: the-agent-auto-accepted-snapshot-updat-82f85023727157c7
description: Puts a human back in the loop when an agent auto-accepts snapshot updates in its own PR. Use when an agent's PR contains snapshot changes with no visual review, or when setting policy for agent-authored UI changes. Not for text-only snapshot updates with no visual content, and not for human-authored snapshot changes that already went through review.

name: the-agent-auto-approved-a-security-pr-bf58e03c442dcb76
description: Use when a dependabot security PR that is really a major bump got auto-merged and broke things. Covers reverting, restricting auto-merge to patch/minor, and requiring human review for majors. Not for patch-level security bumps that merge cleanly.

name: the-agent-auto-closed-500-fixed-findin-ead026cd2f365815
description: Stops a vuln agent from auto-closing findings on scanner absence alone by requiring positive fix confirmation. Use when rescans mark CVEs fixed that were actually missed by the scanner, or when closure automation runs ahead of real remediation. Key trigger: closed findings reappear on the next full scan.

name: the-agent-closed-200-cves-as-fixed-bec-40dc4209a67acb0f
description: Use when a base-image change made scanner findings vanish and the agent closed them as fixed. Covers reopening, requiring positive fix evidence before closure, and alerting on suspicious finding-count drops. Not for genuinely remediated CVEs.

name: the-agent-couldn-t-find-the-leaked-env-4c2745344ce020fb
description: A worker-wide environment audit for leaked env vars: when a test sets an environment variable and never unsets it, every later test on the same worker sees the polluted value, and reading the failing test's code will never reveal it. Use when a test behaves as if configured wrong but its own code is clean. Not for env vars set by CI config or the shell before the run.

name: the-agent-couldn-t-parse-fixed-in-from-f183cfb1fa910bb0
description: Use when RHEL CVEs stay open because the agent cannot extract fixed versions from errata prose. Covers switching to structured errata sources, NVR comparison, and closing confirmed-patched CVEs. Not for non-RHEL ecosystems.

name: the-agent-couldn-t-tell-a-genuine-perf-18b73aa37baae45e
description: A runtime-baselining playbook: without a recorded history of each test's duration, every timing failure looks like noise and real regressions slip through. Use when timing failures get dismissed as flakes with no data to judge them against. Not for one-off slowness with an obvious environmental cause.

name: the-agent-crowd
description: Gate discipline for high-stakes agent verdicts, built on LLM empirics (sycophancy, anchoring, correlated errors, context contamination) and aggregation theory (Galton / Condorcet / Surowiecki); crowd psychology supplies the naming metaphor and failure narrative, never its mechanisms. Use at acceptance gates (ship / no-ship), decision gates (spec sign-off, merge to main, architecture choice), external gates (public release, spending, data deletion, outbound content), or trust gates (about to act on an agent team's collectively confident conclusion); when dispatching reviewer/critic agents at o…

name: the-agent-deduped-ghsa-ids-and-cve-ids-5dc292efe764d8ac
description: Use when the same vulnerability gets triaged twice under its GHSA and CVE identifiers. Covers alias-aware dedup via OSV/GitHub advisory aliases and merging the duplicate tickets. Not for genuinely distinct CVEs.

name: the-agent-economy-report
description: Answer questions from Lorikeet's The Agent Economy report (October 2026, 1,966 US consumers) on how people use AI agents to deal with companies, and check how agent-ready a business is. Use for questions about consumer AI agents contacting businesses, machine customers, B2A (business-to-agent), agent-ready customer service, AI agents negotiating prices or handling refunds and cancellations, Meta Muse and personal agents, or "should we block AI agents", even when the report isn't named.

name: the-agent-filed-the-cve-ticket-against-f4725ffa022210db
description: Use when CVE tickets land on the wrong team because a multi-app image confused the agent's service mapping. Covers building an image-to-service map from deployment manifests and forcing the agent to look up instead of guess. Not for scanner false positives.

name: the-agent-fixed-the-symptom-in-ci-conf-c0e55582234442d8
description: Fixes agents that patch CI config to make a test green in the pipeline while it still fails on developer machines. Use when CI is green, local runs are red, and the change touched only CI config. Reproduce locally, make the test hermetic so it passes anywhere, and validate config changes against a dev machine. Not for intentionally CI-only tests, and not for documented, accepted environment differences.

name: the-agent-grouped-cves-by-package-name-04fb39773fed8f0b
description: Use when CVE grouping by display name splits one library's findings across its old and new names. Covers PURL-based canonical identity, maintaining a rename-alias map, and fixing the remediation to cover both. Not for genuinely distinct libraries.

name: the-agent-hallucinated-blocklist-entri-26b02fac35c477c4
description: Stops an agent hallucinating blocklist entries that were never published, by requiring entries to cite a verified indicator source before sync. Use when downstream filters receive block entries with no corresponding approved indicator. Not for legitimate entries whose publication record is merely misfiled.

name: the-agent-hit-nvd-s-403-rate-limit-eve-40aa43f67fd7d566
description: Fixes NVD API 403 rate-limit errors by replacing per-CVE requests with batched, cached bulk pulls. Use when the agent makes one NVD request per CVE even with an API key, or when enrichment jobs die on 403s. Key trigger: request count scales with CVE count instead of staying flat.

name: the-agent-keeps-chasing-the-failing-te-94d464f01df16d58
description: An upstream-first debugging discipline for state leaks: when the failing test's logs show nothing wrong, the corruption came from an earlier passing test, and more log-reading on the victim is wasted effort. Use when repeated victim-focused investigation keeps coming up empty. Not for failures where the victim's own logs actually show the defect.

name: the-agent-kept-re-quarantining-the-sam-c24257470fcee441
description: Fixes an agent that keeps re-quarantining the same message after its release action fails, by checking action results and escalating instead of retrying blindly. Use when a release or quarantine action loops on one message across runs. Not for messages that genuinely need re-quarantining after re-delivery.

name: the-agent-keyed-tickets-on-cve-plus-im-f07b5ad810e44181
description: Fixes mass re-filing of findings when image tags get rebuilt by keying tickets on the immutable image digest instead of the mutable tag. Use when every finding re-files as new overnight after a tag rebuild. Key trigger: dedup keyed on CVE plus image tag, tag rebuilt, everything re-filed as new.

name: the-agent-leaked-its-nvd-api-key-into-aae7850fe7f03bb0
description: Recovers from an NVD API key leaked into agent logs via rotation, log redaction, and secret-store sourcing. Use when a key appears in log output, or when rotating a key breaks scheduled enrichment jobs that had it hardcoded. Key trigger: the same key value shows up in more than one place.

name: the-agent-marked-a-cve-fixed-but-the-r-1c2c86de3a1de720
description: Fixes a CVE that a rescan still flags after patching, because the patch bumped the package in the builder stage while the vulnerable copy ships in the final stage. Use it when the lockfile shows the fixed version but the scanner keeps reporting the CVE on the built image. Key trigger: the installed package version differs between build stages of a multi-stage Dockerfile.

name: the-agent-marked-a-cve-not-exploitable-b6dc7b2a1ce1d744
description: Rebuilds an auditable evidence trail behind 'not exploitable' verdicts: every such verdict must carry the call path or the proof of its absence, the code revision checked, and a VEX statement with justification. Use it when an auditor asks for the basis of a verdict and the ticket is empty. Key trigger: a 'not exploitable' verdict with no attached evidence.

name: the-agent-overwrote-trivyignore-with-i-dad7ae8bd8022a94
description: Use when a scan agent manages .trivyignore and the team's hand-curated suppressions disappeared. Covers restoring the curated file, switching the agent to append-only output, and locking the file against future overwrites. Not for trivy scan failures or for writing the initial ignore list.

name: the-agent-paged-on-call-for-a-cve-in-a-c0cf5a08716c66a1
description: Use when CVE alerts fire against workloads that are paused, draining, or being decommissioned. Covers feeding workload state into alert routing, suppressing pages for dead namespaces, and keeping a decommission list the agent reads. Not for active-workload CVE triage.

name: the-agent-parsed-red-hat-s-csaf-feed-b-53e3190dbed15c88
description: Replaces a hand-rolled Red Hat CSAF parser with spec-based parsing so moved fields stop breaking patch detection. Use when fixed versions look missing after a CSAF feed update, or when the agent parses CSAF JSON by field position. Key trigger: patch data vanished with no change in your code.

name: the-agent-posted-the-triage-summary-to-dedcaf9a45ab5909
description: Use when security alerts go to the wrong channel and the right team misses them. Covers config-driven channel routing, validating destinations at startup, and confirming delivery. Not for alert content or triage quality.

name: the-agent-processed-the-backlog-in-sev-0d0e440f720b5ec2
description: Use when a triage run re-processes items because live feed updates re-sorted the backlog mid-run. Covers snapshotting the work list at run start, deferring rescores to the next run, and resumable progress. Not for genuinely new CVEs arriving mid-run.

name: the-agent-quarantined-a-test-for-flake-b6df96f26047874b
description: Rescues a test that was quarantined as a flake when it was actually catching a real deploy config error. Use it when a skipped test turns out to be the only signal for a config or environment mistake in the release pipeline. Not for tests that genuinely flake on timing, and not for deploy failures with no test coverage at all.

name: the-agent-ran-trivy-with-severity-high-9feae3c6a956e22b
description: Use when a severity filter hid a KEV-listed CVE and the report claimed zero findings. Covers rescanning without the filter, making KEV membership override severity filters, and KEV-first triage. Not for tuning severity thresholds in general.

name: the-agent-re-triaged-the-same-backlog-14c5c712125bd0b4
description: Fixes a triage agent that re-processes its whole backlog repeatedly because the last-seen timestamp never reaches the database. Use it when every run treats all findings as new even though prior runs completed. Key trigger: the last-seen column in the database is null or frozen at an old date while runs keep succeeding.

name: the-agent-s-api-key-was-revoked-mid-ca-4d0284e95357756f
description: Handles an agent whose URL reputation API key was revoked mid-campaign, restoring access legitimately and degrading triage gracefully meanwhile. Use when reputation lookups suddenly fail with key errors during an active campaign. Not for keys that hit a usage quota, which recover with time or a plan change.

name: the-agent-s-ast-grep-rewrite-rule-kept-8894b45233bb1f00
description: Fixes an ast-grep rewrite rule that loops, appending the same import on every scan because the pattern matches its own insertion. Use when ast-grep update-all grows the file each run. Key trigger: the import count increases with every scan.

name: the-agent-s-bisection-found-no-culprit-1973b77286904a9e
description: Extends bisection past single-test removal when the order dependency needs three specific tests in sequence to trigger. Use it when the agent's bisect found nothing because removing any one test hides the failure. Not for single-polluter ordering bugs that bisect finds fine, and not for timing flakes unrelated to test order.

name: the-agent-s-browser-automation-failed-d4e4b85e6babdc03
description: Fixes an agent browser automation failing on a bank portal login when the MFA push never arrives: switch the step to a channel the portal supports unattended, add a human-approval checkpoint, or move to an API or file channel. Use when MFA blocks automation. Not for wrong usernames or passwords.

name: the-agent-s-campaign-report-exceeded-t-03bf7d538db3276f
description: Fixes a campaign report that exceeds the context limit so its IOC list never exports, by generating the IOC list with code and the narrative separately. Use when reporting fails at the export step on large campaigns. Not for small campaign reports that fit comfortably.

name: the-agent-s-codemod-added-the-same-esl-277b5b3166886266
description: Fixes a codemod that appends the same eslint-disable comment on every run. Use when files grow a new duplicate comment with each pass and re-linting never converges. Key trigger: N identical disable comments after N runs.

name: the-agent-s-codemod-converted-200-file-dedbf43017351526
description: Fixes resuming a codemod that crashed after converting 200 files, leaving the repo half on the old API. Use when tests fail both ways and the transform needs a safe resume point. Key trigger: git shows ~200 modified files and the rest still use the old API.

name: the-agent-s-credential-expired-mid-swe-9c006ea888818e3e
description: Restores a triage agent whose credential expired mid-sweep and broke mailbox access, by rotating to a longer-lived credential model and adding expiry monitoring. Use when mailbox access fails across a sweep with credential errors. Not for a single mailbox permission removal.

name: the-agent-s-csv-parser-broke-on-the-ba-ea94531fe60d4b10
description: Fixes an agent CSV parser breaking on a bank's semicolon-delimited file with quoted newlines: configure the parser for the real dialect, delimiter, quoting, and line endings, instead of assuming commas. Use when the file is valid but the parser reads it wrong. Not for files that are genuinely corrupt.

name: the-agent-s-cvss-recompute-disagreed-w-0ff8fa0fe6ffc928
description: Use when an agent recalculated a CVSS score, disagreed with NVD, and replaced the official score in the ticket. Covers restoring NVD as source of truth, storing the agent's score separately, and requiring human sign-off for overrides. Not for disputing a genuinely wrong NVD score.

name: the-agent-s-data-migration-copied-60-p-6f011f107147aeda
description: Fixes resuming a bulk data copy that died at 60 percent with no transaction and no watermark. Use when re-running the backfill would duplicate rows. Key trigger: the connection dropped mid-copy; batches weren't idempotent.

name: the-agent-s-debian-security-tracker-sc-ba1dad8ea8f3736b
description: Fixes Debian security tracker scrapers that broke when the tracker moved to a JSON format by switching from HTML scraping to the tracker's JSON data endpoint. Use when an agent's Debian tracker scrape returns empty or garbage after the format change. Key trigger: Debian security tracker scrape broke on the new JSON format.

name: the-agent-s-dedup-keyed-on-image-diges-bbc68c224540e809
description: Use when a registry retag makes one digest look like two images and the report contradicts itself. Covers tracking tag-to-digest history, fixing the dedup key, and reconciling the report. Not for genuinely distinct images sharing layers.

name: the-agent-s-defender-api-session-broke-6f5a282588a0736e
description: Restores a triage agent Defender API session broken by a password or credential rotation it did not know about, by moving the agent to rotation-proof credentials. Use when API access breaks immediately after an account credential change. Not for rotations the agent was notified of and updated for.

name: the-agent-s-diff-flagged-every-defined-265a4cf32dc3d0d9
description: Fixes diffs that flag every defined term as changed when the counterparty just capitalized them all: casing treated as substantive. It shows how to compare defined terms case-insensitively and keep casing as display-only. Use it when a capitalization pass floods your redline with term changes that mean nothing.

name: the-agent-s-diff-flagged-the-entire-si-27f90f6c252f9a5f
description: Fixes diffs that flag the whole signature block as deleted when the counterparty switches page size, like Letter to A4, shifting every page break. It shows how to diff at the paragraph level ignoring pagination, and how to treat signature blocks as structured content. Use it when a page-size or margin change makes your redline agent report deletions that are really just repagination.

name: the-agent-s-diff-treated-a-reordered-e-21cf4258b9128baa
description: Fixes exhibit-list diffs that report a reorder as 12 deletions plus 12 additions: the agent never realigned the list items. It shows how to match list items by content across versions, detect moves, and compare lists independent of order. Use it when reordered exhibits, schedules, or numbered lists produce deletion-heavy diffs that scare reviewers.

name: the-agent-s-exploitability-assessment-214b8933cbd14a91
description: Fixes an LLM triage agent that contradicts itself on whether a vulnerable function is reachable by making every verdict evidence-bound: no call path, no 'not reachable.' Use it when two runs of the same agent disagree on exploitability for identical code. Key trigger: contradictory reachability verdicts across runs with no code change.

name: the-agent-s-exploitability-verdict-rel-1f75d8cb6557acec
description: Use when exploitability verdicts change because advisory prose was reworded, not because facts changed. Covers evidence-backed verdicts, ignoring prose-only diffs, and versioning verdicts with evidence hashes. Not for new technical information in an advisory update.

name: the-agent-s-extraction-returned-comple-c2e66af36c3943f3
description: Fixes false 'complete' reports in contract extraction: the agent said extraction was complete while the last 30 pages of schedules never entered context. It shows how to gate the complete flag on an independent page count, verify pages-in equals pages-processed, and make incompleteness impossible to misreport. Use it when extraction reports success but you suspect trailing pages were never read.

name: the-agent-s-flyway-run-lost-its-connec-8eb613a6a073e291
description: Fixes a Flyway run where the schema history row committed but the data copy did not finish after a connection loss. It shows how to verify what data actually landed, remove the misleading history row, and re-run safely, plus how to split schema and data migrations so it cannot recur. Use when flyway_schema_history disagrees with the real table contents.

name: the-agent-s-ignore-rule-expired-silent-21099674b982de5c
description: Use when expired suppressions return as a flood of new findings with no warning. Covers re-applying after review, expiry notifications, and treating mass reappearance as an incident. Not for first-time triage of genuinely new CVEs.

name: the-agent-s-ioc-extractor-failed-on-ba-46a8562134d56872
description: Fixes an agent IOC extractor failing on base64-encoded message bodies, by decoding MIME parts before extraction. Use when indicators are missed because the body or attachment content arrives base64 encoded. Not for messages where indicators are absent for other reasons.

name: the-agent-s-jscodeshift-transform-doub-8ea4298c1f7b66e9
description: Fixes a jscodeshift transform that isn't idempotent and double-wraps components in React.memo on re-run. Use when a codemod changes its own output so running it twice produces different results. Key trigger: components wrapped in memo(memo(...)) after a second pass.

name: the-agent-s-kev-due-date-math-was-off-889d7c79fa012a02
description: Fixes KEV due-date math that flags CVEs as overdue a week early because of a timezone mix-up. Use it when a triage agent marks CISA KEV entries overdue that are not actually due yet. Key trigger: the overdue list shifts by exactly the UTC offset of the agent's timezone.

name: the-agent-s-kev-watch-checked-the-cata-ccf15dd2a26cafa5
description: Use when KEV due dates are computed from the wrong start date or the catalog is polled too slowly. Covers using CISA's dateAdded, polling daily, and recomputing open KEV tickets. Not for non-KEV CVE prioritization.

name: the-agent-s-kubectl-is-1-29-but-the-cl-866e677584e3a5f0
description: Fixes manifests rejected by the API server when the agent's kubectl is too new for the cluster. It shows how to confirm the version skew, install a matching kubectl, and validate server-side before applying. Use when kubectl applies fail against an older cluster.

name: the-agent-s-last-scan-watermark-advanc-190c52a002ce0dc8
description: Use when a scan watermark or checkpoint moved forward despite a failed scan, causing the next run to skip unscanned assets. Covers success-only watermark writes, resetting the watermark, and backfilling missed scans. Not for slow or partial scans that genuinely completed.

name: the-agent-s-nightly-fleet-scan-only-fi-52ec92c9e6f40fdb
description: Fixes nightly fleet scans that never finish in the maintenance window by parallelizing workers, caching the vulnerability DB once per host, and skipping unchanged image digests. Use when an agent scans a container fleet sequentially and only a fraction completes before the window closes. Key trigger: nightly scan finishes only 60 of 200 images.

name: the-agent-s-nvd-cve-feed-parser-broke-80f988cb47f12703
description: Fixes NVD feed parsers that silently match zero CVEs after the NVD 2.0 schema change by updating the configurations node path and adding a zero-match canary alert. Use when a CVE matcher returns no results overnight with no error after an NVD schema update. Key trigger: NVD parser broke and the matcher silently returned zero CVEs.

name: the-agent-s-one-click-unsubscribe-link-62f3c2ee4d19e0d9
description: Fixes a broken one-click unsubscribe link (404 or error page) that turns routine opt-outs into spam complaints and damages the sending domain's reputation. Use when unsubscribe links fail, return errors, or were never end-to-end tested. Not for deliverability issues with working links, or for consent and list-quality problems.

name: the-agent-s-one-pr-per-cve-policy-crea-23098480ec6fcdd8
description: Replaces a one-PR-per-CVE policy with root-cause grouping: when many CVEs trace to one shared transitive dependency, a single bump PR closes them all. Use it when the backlog is full of duplicate fix PRs for the same underlying package. Key trigger: many CVE tickets converging on one shared dependency.

name: the-agent-s-osv-aliases-parser-broke-w-7afefaea30f5ccab
description: Fixes an OSV aliases parser to read both the active and withdrawn alias arrays after the schema change. Use when alias lookups suddenly return nothing, or when dedup starts missing matches that used to resolve. Key trigger: OSV responses now carry a separate withdrawn aliases array your parser ignores.

name: the-agent-s-patch-validation-only-re-r-e9f84297b008d163
description: Use when patch validation checks the lockfile but the deployed artifact still carries the vulnerable layer. Covers validating the deployed image digest, wiring validation to post-deploy scans, and closing only on artifact evidence. Not for lockfile-only projects with no deployed image.

name: the-agent-s-pdf-parser-broke-on-a-smug-f28e89ffea045385
description: Fixes an agent PDF parser that breaks on an HTML smuggling sample carried in or beside a PDF, by separating document parsing from HTML analysis. Use when PDF parsing crashes or returns garbage on a smuggled or hybrid attachment. Not for scanned-image PDFs that need OCR.

name: the-agent-s-per-cve-nvd-lookups-took-6-61015edee0146438
description: Replaces per-CVE NVD API lookups with a locally synced bulk mirror for fast enrichment. Use when per-CVE lookups take hours, or when the enrichment pipeline's runtime is dominated by NVD round trips. Key trigger: enrichment time grows linearly with backlog size.

name: the-agent-s-prisma-migrate-diff-said-t-3125924a0fc17fb0
description: Fixes the confusion when prisma migrate diff says no-op but migrate deploy still has work to do. It explains that the two commands answer different questions - diff compares schema to database, deploy compares migration files to history - and shows the status-first workflow that removes the surprise. Use when Prisma's dry-run and deploy seem to disagree.

name: the-agent-s-prisma-migrate-lost-its-da-7e0465299c50b70b
description: Fixes a Prisma migration blocked by a failed row in _prisma_migrations after a lost database connection. Use when migrate deploy refuses to run until the failed migration is resolved. Key trigger: a row with finished_at null in _prisma_migrations; choose migrate resolve --applied vs --rolled-back.

name: the-agent-s-python-libcst-codemod-dupl-acf63b11417a5706
description: Fixes a Python libcst codemod that duplicates decorators on every run. Use when re-running a decorator-adding transform mid-migration isn't safe. Key trigger: the same decorator stacked N times after N runs.

name: the-agent-s-quarantine-list-silently-g-ac1349b0fc0aaefe

name: throttle

allowed_tools: Bash(throttle *), Bash(throttle-ack *), Bash(jht-throttle *), Bash(jht-throttle-check *), Bash(jht-throttle-wait *), Bash(python3 /app/shared/skills/throttle_engine.py *)

name: throttle-ack

Only you can do it - the engine cannot - which is exactly why a flag left on NOTIFIED is proof that an agent got the wake-up and did not respond, and why the watchdog escalates on it. Applies when a project contains tiapp.xml, with Alloy app/ or Classic Resources/ sources. Use ti-api for individual API contracts, alloy-guides for MVC, and ti-howtos for native integrations.

name: ti-hiring-operations

name: ti-hnparse

name: ti-howto
description: 【ベータ】ツバイソPSA/IMAの「この機能はできますか」「この画面で何をどの順に押しますか」「この挙動は仕様ですか・なぜこうなりますか」に、製品ナレッジ（ヘルプ記事）を引いて出典つきで答えるスキル。TRIGGER when 「〜はできますか」「〜に対応していますか」「〜の仕様は」「〜はどうやりますか」「〜の設定はどこで行いますか」「なぜこうなりますか・これは不具合ですか」と、製品の使い方・可否・仕様を問われたとき。会話がこの問いから始まるときの入口。DO NOT TRIGGER when 画面がメニューのどこにあるか・どう開くかは ti-navigate、データの中身・金額・件数の集計は ti-reference、レコードの作成・更新は ti-update、カスタマイズの実装は ti-metadata、接続・環境セットアップと TI そのものの使い方（「TIの使い方を教えて」）は ti-rollout。

name: ti-howtos

Triggers include tiapp.xml and calls to Ti.Geolocation, Ti.Media, Ti.Database, Ti.Network or third-party modules.

name: ti-industry-advisor
description: 高职课程行业顾问技能（行业顾问随身技能·通用壳）。构建/维护行业知识库（教材解读/案例台账/工艺方法）， 为全团流程专家提供行业专业知识（咨询模式）；默认加载影视行业知识库（film）。当用户需要行业知识、 教材专业解读、案例供给、课程案例专业性把关时使用。

name: ti-ingest
description: Threat-intel signal ingest — converts a CVE + affected-asset + claim payload into a queued engagement-scope row for the validation pipeline.

name: ti-ioc-extraction
description: Automated IOC extraction from threat reports, logs, and unstructured text — parse hashes, IPs, domains, URLs, email addresses, and CVEs. Covers regex-based extraction, defanging/refanging, bulk hash lookup, IOC deduplication, YARA rule generation from IOCs, and STIX/TAXII formatting for sharing.

name: ti-ioc-extraction
description: Automated IOC extraction from threat r...

name: ti-lifecycle
description: 顧客orgカスタマイズを「どの実装形態で・いつ作るか」で判断する開発運用ライフサイクル判断スキル。TRIGGER when 個別要件を宣言的（Flow/入力規則/数式/承認）・Apex・外部スクリプト・製品機能化のどれで実装するかの選択、Anonymous Apex で作ってよいか／運用フェーズへ移行してよいかの判断、着手前ゲートの適用。DO NOT TRIGGER when 導入プロジェクト全体の工程進行は ti-onboarding、契約前の体験演出は ti-poc、メタデータ配備の機構そのものは ti-metadata、個別レコードの申請前・承認前チェックは ti-update。

name: ti-linux-boot-chain
description: Explain, locate, rebuild and sanity-check the TI K3 boot binaries (tiboot3.bin, tispl.bin, u-boot.img, fitImage) and the device-manager (DM) firmware inside tispl.bin, and choose the right tiboot3 variant for a GP, HS-FS or HS-SE device. Use when a board does not reach U-Boot, when boot files must be rebuilt or copied to an SD/eMMC boot partition, or when asked how the K3 boot flow works. Older Sitara parts (MLO + u-boot.img) are detected and reported as a different flow.

name: ti-linux-build-source
description: Build the Linux kernel, device tree blobs, and U-Boot boot binaries (R5/A-core or single-stage, depending on the SoC) from the SDK sources using the SDK top-level Makefile and Rules.make, locate the outputs, rebuild incrementally, and change kernel config. Use when the user wants to compile the kernel, DTBs or bootloaders from the SDK tree. For the Yocto/bitbake path use ti-linux-yocto-build instead.

name: ti-linux-custom-board-port
description: Derive a custom board from a TI Processor SDK reference board: clone the kernel board DTS, the U-Boot R5 and A53 device trees and defconfigs, regenerate DDR/board configuration, and build and boot it with the SDK makefiles. Use when the user has their own carrier or SoM hardware based on a TI K3 SoC and needs boot (tiboot3/tispl/u-boot.img) plus Linux DTB for it.

name: ti-linux-customize-clocks
description: Inspect and change CPU frequency scaling (cpufreq sysfs, governors, the A53 OPP table in the kernel DTS) and set LPM resume-latency constraints (pm_qos_resume_latency_us) on a K3 Processor SDK Linux target. Use when the user asks about CPU frequency, governors, OPPs, disabling or limiting an OPP, DVFS, or which low power mode the SoC enters.

name: ti-linux-deploy-image
description: Put built or prebuilt SDK images on a TI board - create an SD card with the SDK bin/create-sdcard.sh or the Makefile install targets (DESTDIR), copy boot files, flash boot binaries and rootfs to eMMC, set up TFTP/NFS network boot with the SDK helper scripts, and persist U-Boot variables with uEnv.txt. Use after ti-linux-build-source, or when the user asks to flash, write an SD card, boot from eMMC, or boot over the network.

name: ti-linux-device-tree-overlay
description: Write, build, install and enable a device tree overlay (.dtso to .dtbo) for a TI K3 board running the Processor SDK Linux: build with the SDK kernel tree, test-apply it to the board's base DTB on the host, copy it to the SD card and enable it from U-Boot with name_overlays in uEnv.txt. Use when enabling a daughter card, panel, camera, CAN/PWM/eQEP option or extra pinmux without rebuilding the base board DTB.

name: ti-linux-diagnostic
description: Read-only health snapshot of a running TI K3 board (identity, kernel, memory, thermal, cpufreq, remoteproc, disks, failed units, dmesg errors) as JSON. Use to validate a deployment or to start debugging a board.

name: ti-linux-generate-kb
description: Generate or refresh the per-platform knowledge base (cores and firmware names, reserved memory, OPPs, IOPAD macros, GPIO, overlays, boot files, component versions) from the installed TI Processor SDK sources. Use after installing the skills, when the SDK or kernel changed, when $TI_KB is missing or stale, or when a skill needs device facts.

name: ti-linux-gpio-pinmux
description: Configure and debug pin multiplexing and GPIO on a TI K3 Linux board: write pinctrl-single IOPAD entries in device tree, read live pad registers from debugfs, decode pad values, and test lines from user space with libgpiod v2. Use when a pin needs a different function/pull/direction, a peripheral does not get its pins, a pin conflict is suspected, or a GPIO must be read or driven.

name: ti-linux-kernel-module
description: Cross-compile an out-of-tree Linux kernel module against the kernel tree shipped in a TI Processor SDK, check that it matches the kernel running on the board, and load it. Use when the user wants to build, rebuild or deploy a custom driver (.ko), asks why insmod says "Invalid module format", or asks how to build modules for the SDK kernel. Uses the toolchain and architecture from the SDK Rules.make.

name: ti-linux-pru
description: Build and run PRU (Programmable Real-time Unit, PRU-ICSS / ICSSG PRU, RTU, TX_PRU) firmware on a TI board from Linux: gate on PRU presence in the device tree, build an SDK example with the PRU compiler, load it through remoteproc, and talk to it over RPMsg. Use when the user mentions PRU, PRU-ICSS, ICSSG, RTU, TX_PRU or real-time I/O firmware. Some SoCs (for example AM62P) have no PRU: the skill stops there.

name: ti-linux-remoteproc
description: Discover, load, reload and verify firmware on the remote processors (R5F, M4F, ...) of a TI K3 or Sitara board through the Linux remoteproc and RPMsg interfaces. Core list comes from the device tree and /sys/class/remoteproc, never from memory. Use when asked to run firmware on a secondary core, swap an IPC example, read a core's trace log, check rpmsg devices, or find out which cores exist and which one Linux may load. PRU cores are covered by ti-linux-pru.

name: ti-linux-resource-partition
description: Locate and understand the K3 Resource Partitioning tool shipped in the SDK (board-support/k3-respart-tool, SysConfig based) and its generated outputs (.syscfg, *_qos.h) used for DMA/ring/interrupt allocation and QoS. Use when the user asks about resource partitioning, DMA channel or ring allocation between cores, QoS settings, or regenerating the firmware resource configuration.

name: ti-linux-sdk-quick-start
description: Entry point and router for TI Processor SDK Linux work. Gathers the few inputs every other skill needs (SDK path, board IP, boot medium, security mode) and sends the user through Setup, Customize, Build, Deploy, Validate by naming the skill for each phase. Use at the start of a session, or when the user says "get started", "set up my board", or is unsure which skill applies.

name: ti-linux-sdk-setup
description: Install or locate a TI Processor SDK Linux tree, check the build host, load device values (SOC, PLATFORM, toolchain, U-Boot machines) from the SDK Rules.make into the shell, and confirm the docs MCP works. Use first in any session, when the user mentions installing the SDK, SDK path, toolchain, Rules.make, host requirements, or before ti-linux-build-source / ti-linux-deploy-image.

name: ti-linux-serial-console
description: Access the target board's serial console to capture boot logs (ROM, SPL, U-Boot, kernel) and interact with the bootloader. Use when the board has no network, when debugging early boot failures, or when you need to interrupt U-Boot.

name: ti-linux-yocto-build
description: Set up and run the TI Processor SDK Yocto (Arago / OpenEmbedded) build on a Linux host with oe-layersetup and bitbake: check host prerequisites, pick the layer configuration file for the SDK release, build tisdk-default-image and related targets, rebuild one recipe, and find the output images. Use when the user wants a full SDK image from source, an RT or Jailhouse image, a single recipe rebuild, or hits a Yocto build setup problem. Customising the device tree inside Yocto is ti-linux-yocto-custom-dt.

name: ti-linux-yocto-custom-dt
description: Carry a custom device tree or overlay from the Processor SDK kernel tree into a Yocto (Arago/oe-layersetup) image build of the same SDK. Use after the DTS works with the SDK `make linux-dtbs` flow and the user wants it in a bitbake-built image; also to find which kernel recipe, machine config and DTB list the Yocto build uses. Unverified Yocto details are marked "check docs" instead of guessed.

name: ti-local-automation
description: 本人権限内で PSA/IMA を任意の Salesforce API（REST/Tooling/Bulk/Composite/バイナリ/独自 Apex REST）でローカル操作する能力スキル。TRIGGER when 標準 MCP ツールに無い API 操作・商談等への数KBを超える・バイナリのファイル添付＋公開リンク発行・数KBを超える・バイナリの授受・Bulk/Composite・独自 Apex REST 呼び出しをローカルスクリプトで行う、Salesforceの接続の dispatch で userType に builder を付けても画面の制約で拒否された書き込み（選択リスト値に無い件名・メール記録の作成・除けない参照のみの項目）を、更新用のコネクタ（createSobjectRecord・updateSobjectRecord）が無いときに実行する。DO NOT TRIGGER when 会話内の少量の参照・更新（標準 MCP で足りる）=標準 MCP/ti-update、会話の接続に任意のREST呼び出しを受けるツール（dispatch系）があるときの公開リンクの1件発行・入力規則やフロー定義の読み取り（会話の接続で足りる）、業務データの一括移行の型と機構=ti-data-load、メタデータ定義の配備=ti-metadata、接続・認証の準備そのもの=ti-rol…

name: ti-metadata
description: AI が PSA/IMA と整合してメタデータ＝カスタマイズ（カスタム項目・権限セット・入力規則・承認プロセス・FlexiPage・レポートタイプ・リストビュー・Apexトリガー・Flow オーバーライド・Lightning Web コンポーネント・静的リソース・Visualforce ページ・非トリガ Apex クラス・カスタムメタデータ・共有ルール(SharingRules)/OWD＝共有モデル設定・ラベル/選択リスト値の翻訳 等）を差分方式で設定する手順とスクリプト。アップグレード時の再検証、当社の拡張アプリの導入・版上げ・設定変更・アンインストールと、カスタマイズ設計書・仕様書の出力も担う

name: ti-navigate
description: 【ベータ】ツバイソPSA/IMAの「その画面はどこにあるか・どうやって開くか」に、クリック経路と直リンクで答えるスキル。TRIGGER when 「〜はどこで見られますか」「〜はどこから入れますか」「〜の画面を開く手順を教えて」「操作手順を順番に教えて」「案件から発注へはどう行きますか」、社員教育・サポート応答・デモ台本づくりで画面の場所や開き方を答えるとき、レポートやダッシュボードの置き場を尋ねられたとき。DO NOT TRIGGER when データの中身・金額・件数を取る集計は ti-reference、レコードの作成・更新は ti-update、画面そのものを作る・配置する（カスタムメタデータの配備）は ti-metadata、帳票レイアウトは ti-report、接続・環境セットアップは ti-rollout。

name: ti-office-docs
description: 高职课程文档生成技能（Office 文档专家随身技能）。把 md 母本生成可编辑的 docx/pptx/xlsx： md2docx（对齐 L0-L3 模板骨架）、md2pptx（16:9 原生形状+风格引擎）、md2xlsx（结构化数据）； 维护模板库/风格库/用户模板收集区；文档质量校验。当用户要求把 md/内容做成 Word/PPT/Excel 成品时使用。

name: ti-onboarding
description: 【ベータ】本番導入プロジェクトを工程進行・段取りする導入支援スキル（PSA/ERP導入・契約後寄り）。TRIGGER when 導入計画の立案・タスク分解、Fit&Gap や重要マスタ設計の工程進行、7工程（計画・管理／設計／制作／構築・設定／データ移行／教育／運用テスト）の現在地把握と次工程の段取り、Sandbox→本番への着地支援、必要な業務領域から順に立ち上げる部分導入の段取り、稼働後に新しい業務・新しい商品/サービスの事業が加わったときの業務プロセス・登録方式・マスタ設計の検討、要件定義でツバイソへの確認事項（ツバイソ照会票・「ツバイソ社確認」）を作る・受け取るとき、利用者が「ツバイソに照会したい」「ツバイソに聞きたい」と言ったとき、確認事項の一覧をまとめて入力（貼り付け・添付・リンクの提示）されて回答や照会票を求められたとき、Fit&Gap で利用者が TI の回答を Sandbox またはトライアルの組織で確認する（実機確認）とき・確認結果を伝えたとき。DO NOT TRIGGER when 契約前の価値実証は ti-poc、個別要件の実装形態や Anonymous Apex 可否・運用移行の判断は ti-lifecycle、単一の能力で完結する作業は層2スキル（ti-reference 等）。

name: ti-poc
description: 契約前の PoC・商談・社内検証で見込み客に「導入が簡単・速い」を体験させるトライアル体験スキル（契約前寄り）。TRIGGER when トライアル環境での価値実証、業務プロセスの可視化・理解、サンプルデータでの多軸集計デモ、少量の自社マスタや注文書・請求書を取り込む体験、デモ用サンプルデータの準備。DO NOT TRIGGER when 本番導入プロジェクトの工程進行は ti-onboarding、実装形態の判断は ti-lifecycle、単一の能力で完結する作業は層2スキル（ti-reference 等）。

name: ti-reference
description: ツバイソPSA/IMA（Salesforce）とツバイソERP（会計）の業務データを参照・集計するときに使う。経費・売上（見積〜受注〜納品〜売上〜請求〜入金消込〜手形電債〜EC連携）・調達（発注〜検収〜仕入経費〜支払・発注EC/仕入先EC）・制作（制作指図〜工数〜原価計算票・進行基準）・管理会計・案件・返品・与信・契約・勤怠・マスタ（通貨/為替/銀行/社員/人件費レート/価格表）・在庫（IMA 倉庫/棚/ロット/受払/月次）・財務記録（汎用仕訳・会計連携）・管理会計2への計上連携のデータを、標準Salesforce MCPで取得するためのスキル。ツバイソERPのデータはERPのMCPで取得する。PSA/IMAのオブジェクトや項目を探すとき、SOQLを組み立てるとき、結果をリンク付きで返すときに必ず読む。製品の仕様・操作手順・可否は ti-howto。

name: ti-report
description: Jinja2 templates + CSS + data contract for TweakIdea evaluation reports

name: ti-report
description: 【ベータ】PSA/IMA顧客の帳票（見積・請求・注文・納品・検収 等）を自社レイアウト・項目へカスタマイズする能力スキル。TRIGGER when 帳票テンプレの新規作成・調整、データの流し込み、押印/DRAFT分岐の組み込み、帳票に出す項目の追加、帳票出力ボタン/描画面のorg配置、帳票の美観仕上げ、帳票項目マッピング設計書・カスタマイズ仕様書の出力と継続修正サイクル。DO NOT TRIGGER when メタデータ配備の機構そのものは ti-metadata、文書→レコードの取込・入力支援は ti-update、導入プロジェクトの工程進行は ti-onboarding。

name: ti-research
description: Guides proactive threat-intel research and current awareness, covering where to look (feeds, RSS, CISA KEV, advisories, CERTs, ORKL) and how to turn scattered reporting into a tracked, cited picture of an actor, campaign or sector threat. Use when the user asks what is new on a threat, for a threat briefing or landscape for their sector, recent activity of an actor, or which intel sources to follow.

name: ti-reuse-first
description: Use before anything new exists in a Titanium or Alloy project — 'hazme un panel de avisos', 'necesito otra pantalla', 'hazlo igual que el de Index', 'voy a copiar paneles/derechos como base', '¿dónde pongo esta función?'. A search order stopping at the first rung that holds: must this exist, is it already in app/, does a Ti.* API, the platform, an installed module or a PurgeTSS class cover it, can it be one line, and only then the smallest thing that works — copied exactly, without guards nobody asked for. AUTO-DETECT: if tiapp.xml exists, invoke BEFORE creating any controller, view, Widget,…
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash(git *), Bash(node *)

name: ti-rollout
description: Tsubaiso Intelligence を顧客環境で使い始めるための接続・環境セットアップを進めるスキル。TRIGGER when 接続・環境セットアップ・MCP/コネクタ結線・カスタムコネクタ登録・Salesforce(PSA/IMA)標準MCP接続・ツバイソERP（会計）のMCP接続・外部クライアントアプリ作成・接続キー取得・初期セットアップ・「TIの使い方を教えて」（接続後の使い始めの練習）。DO NOT TRIGGER when 導入プロジェクトの工程進行・計画立案・Fit&Gap/設計の段取り=ti-onboarding、契約前の価値実証・トライアル体験=ti-poc、データ移行の実行=ti-data-load、MCP に無い任意 API 操作のローカル実行=ti-local-automation、メタデータ＝カスタマイズ定義の生成・デプロイ=ti-metadata。「TIを導入したい」は接続・環境セットアップの局面のみ本スキルが担い、工程進行・計画は ti-onboarding へ寄せる。

name: ti-run-pipelines
description: Run TI-Toolbox pipelines for the user through the app they have open — copy raw DICOM/NIfTI into the project's sourcedata, preprocess (charm head model), flex-search or ex-search optimisation, simulate a montage or an optimisation result, and follow the jobs. Use when the user asks you to DO something with their data in TI-Toolbox ("preprocess sub-101", "optimise for the thalamus", "simulate the best montage"), not to explain it. Needs the ti-toolbox-jobs MCP server.

name: ti-s01-course-direction
description: 高职课程建设九步法「①岗位调研专家」（专家团角色，对外口径由"方向调研"调整为"岗位调研"）。当用户要确认一门新课的方向、做就业情况/区域产业/证书/竞赛调研、明确课程面向的岗位与就业面向，或需要"先定方向再做课标"时使用。调用本技能产出 S01 方向确认与就业调研纪要，作为 S03 能力图谱与 S04 课程标准的输入。触发词：课程方向、就业调研、岗位面向、岗位调研、课程定位、开新课。

name: ti-s01-s09-course-build

description: 국내 주식 진입 타이머. 셋업을 봉 단위로 지켜보다 들어갈 순간을 알려 준다. 토스증권 Open API 1분봉(KRX+NXT 통합 시세)을 5분봉으로 묶어 시가 범위(개장 뒤 15분)를 만들고, 범위가 끝난 뒤 처음으로 범위 고가 "위에서 끝난" 완성 봉을 신호로 본다. 직접 준 가격(스캐너의 20일 신고가 등) 돌파와 거래량 조건도 된다. 대기와 남은 거리, 신호 시각과 가격, 만료, 개장 전을 말하고 trader-kr/entry.json 에 써서 /trader-kr-exit 로 넘긴다. 매수만 본다. 주문은 절대 내지 않는다. 사용자가 "언제 들어가", "삼성전자 지켜봐 줘", "시가 범위 돌파했어?", "진입 신호", "관심 목록 확인", "tell me when to get in", "watch 005930" 이라고 하거나 /trader-kr-scanner 다음, /trader-kr-exit 전에 쓴다.

name: trader-kr-exit
description: 국내 주식 청산 계획. 들어가기 전에 손절가와 목표가를 정해서 언제 나올지 알게 한다. /trader-kr-entry 의 진입(또는 직접 준 가격)에서 손절을 시가 범위 중간값, 범위 저가, 직접 정한 가격, 진입가 아래 %, ATR 배수로 정하고 호가 단위로 내린다. 목표는 위험의 R 배수(기본 2R) 또는 직접 정한 가격으로 호가 단위에 맞춘다. 수수료와 매도 거래세를 뺀 순손익비를 같이 보여 주고, 목표가가 오늘 상한가보다 높으면 거절하고, 손절가가 하한가보다 낮으면 경고한다. 청산 시각(기본 15:15, 종가 단일가 전)까지 이기든 지든 판다. trader-kr/plan.json 에 쓴다. 매수만. 주문은 내지 않는다. 사용자가 "손절 어디로", "목표가 정해 줘", "청산 계획", "얼마 잃어?", "set my stop", "exit plan" 이라고 하거나 /trader-kr-entry 다음, /trader-kr-timemachine 과 /trader-kr-budget 전에 쓴다.

name: trader-kr-insider
description: 국내 주식 임원·주요주주 보고. 상장회사 임원과 주요주주(10% 이상 주주, 사실상 지배주주)가 DART 에 내는 두 보고를 읽는다: 산 뒤에 내는 소유상황보고서와, 사기 30일 전에 내는 거래계획보고서. 관심 종목(스캐너 결과, 계획, 일지의 열린 거래, 또는 직접 준 종목)이나 시장 전체에서 새 보고를 한 번씩만 알리고, 원문에서 거래 줄을 뽑는다: 보고자, 임원 직위나 주주 관계, 장내매수·장내매도·증여·수증 같은 사유, 결제일, 수량, 단가, 변동 후 주식 수, 거래계획의 기간·방법·목적, 마지막 변동일부터 접수까지 평일 수. 보유 중인 종목에는 표시한다. 미공개 정보가 아니고 따라 사라는 말이 아니다. 사용자가 "임원이 샀어?", "대주주 매도", "내부자 매매", "지분 공시", "거래계획 보고", "오너가 주식 팔아?", "insider buying", "insider trades" 라고 하면 쓴다.

name: trader-kr-invest
description: 국내 주식 장기 투자 실험실. 한 달에 한 번 사고파는 장기 전략 16가지(동일가중, 모멘텀 12-1, 저변동성, 소형, 52주 고가 근접, 1개월 반전, 추세 타이밍)를 KRX 일별매매정보 2010년 ~ 지금으로 시험하고, 시가총액 상위 300 보통주를 시가총액 비중대로 들고 가는 기준(B1)과 비용 뒤 월 초과수익으로 비교한다. 그 뒤 상장폐지·합병된 종목도 들어 있어 생존 편향이 없고, 상장폐지를 마지막 가격으로 치는 판과 -100% 로 치는 판을 둘 다 낸다. Newey-West 표준오차와 한쪽 p, 연복리, 변동성, 최대 낙폭, 적립식과 한 번에 넣기 비교를 낸다. value.py 는 가치 규칙 8가지 (저PBR, 저PER, 고배당, 저PBR+고ROE, 저PBR+모멘텀, 그레이엄·버핏·린치 점검표)를 DART 사업보고서(그때 접수된 것만)와 배당을 넣은 수익률로, 해마다 4월 말에 바꿔 시험한다. r4 규칙 4개는 F-score(피오트로스키)와 매출총이익/자산 (노비-마크스)을 쓴다. r5 규칙 5개는 시가총액가중에서 발생액·순발행·적자·F-score 위험 신호가 켜진 종목만 뺀다. forward 는 규칙을 지금 잠그고 앞으로의 달만 채점하는 전진…

name: trader-kr-journal
description: 국내 주식 거래 일지. 실제로 산 가격·시각·수량과 판 가격·시각·이유(손절, 목표, 시간 청산, 직접 청산)를 trader-kr/journal.jsonl 에 적고, 계획(trader-kr/plan.json)과 비교해 계획을 얼마나 지켰는지 숫자로 보여 준다. 거래마다 비용 뺀 R 과 손익, 신호 뒤 몇 분 늦게 들어갔는지, 계획 진입가보다 몇 칸 비싸게 샀는지, 손절가 아래에서 나왔는지(손절을 미뤘는지), 청산 시각을 넘겼는지, 한도를 넘는 수량이었는지를 잰다. 모아서 승률, 평균 R, 낸 비용, 늦은 진입과 제때 진입의 성적 차이, 손절을 어겨 더 잃은 돈, 셋업별 성적을 낸다. 주문을 내지 않는다. 토스증권 앱에서 사고팔았으면 sync 가 본인 계좌의 체결 내역을 읽어 적고(읽기만), holdings 가 보유 주식이 손절가에서 얼마나 떨어져 있는지 보여 준다. 사용자가 "샀어", "팔았어", "체결됐어", "일지에 적어 줘", "토스에서 샀어", "체결 가져와", "내 계좌 봐 줘", "보유 종목", "매매 기록", "내 성적", "복기", "trade journal", "log my trade", "how am I doing" 이라고 하면 쓴다.

name: trader-kr-lab
description: 국내 주식 전략 검증 실험실. 시가 범위 돌파 규칙 48가지(범위 15·30분, 손절 범위 중간·저가·진입가 아래 X%, 목표 1·1.5·2R, 거래량 조건, 비용 필터)를 여러 종목의 토스증권 1분봉 250 거래일에 돌린다. 앞 120 거래일에서 비용 뺀 평균 R 이 가장 큰 규칙을 고르고 뒤 20 거래일에서 확인하기를 기간을 밀며 되풀이해(워크포워드) 고른 뒤의 성적만 모은다. 많이 시험하면 우연히 좋아 보이는 규칙이 섞이므로 홀름 보정 p 값을 붙이고, 고를 때 성적과 시험 기간 성적의 차이(고르는 착시)를 보여 준다. 수수료, 매도 거래세 0.20%, 손절·시간 청산 밀림, 손절가 아래 갭을 넣고, 비용이 이익에서 가져간 몫과 비용 필터의 효과를 잰다. 답은 대개 "남는 게 없다" 이고, 그 답도 그대로 말한다. 사용자가 "이 전략 돈 돼?", "백테스트 제대로", "규칙 검증", "과최적화", "워크포워드", "수익 나는 규칙 찾아 줘", "미래 검증", "규칙 잠가 줘", "does this strategy work", "walk-forward" 라고 하면 쓴다. 주문을 내지 않는다.

name: trader-kr-masters
description: 국내 상장사 한 곳을 투자 대가의 기준으로 재는 점검표. DART 사업보고서 전체 재무제표(2015 사업연도부터)와 KRX 시가총액으로 그레이엄(방어적 투자자 8개), 버핏(7개), 린치(유형 분류와 6개)의 기준을 하나씩 계산하고, 기준마다 숫자, 기준값, 충족 여부를 보여 준다 ("그레이엄 기준 8개 중 5개 충족"). 숫자는 모두 스크립트가 공시 원값에서 내고, Claude 는 그 숫자를 그 대가라면 어떻게 볼지 풀어 쓴다. 매수·매도·강세·약세 신호와 목표가는 내지 않는다. 산 이유(논지)를 근거·위험·촉매로 적어 두고, 숫자 근거는 새 사업보고서로 다시 판정하고 지난 점검 뒤 공시를 보여 주는 논지 추적도 한다 (조치와 확신도는 사용자가 적는다). implied.py 는 지금 시가총액이 깔고 있는 가정을 거꾸로 푼다: PER·PBR·배당수익률의 지난 월말 밴드(그때 알던 사업보고서 기준), 역DCF (앞 10년 잉여현금 성장률), 필요한 ROE. 사용자가 "버핏이라면 이 회사 어떻게 볼까", "그레이엄 기준으로", "린치 PEG", "대가들 관점", "가치투자 점검", "논지 적어 줘", "내 논지 아직 유효해?", "thesis check", "…

name: trader-kr-news
description: 국내 주식 공시 알림. 관심 종목(스캐너 결과, 청산 계획, 오늘 계획들, 일지의 열린 거래, 또는 직접 준 종목)에 새로 나온 DART 공시만 최신 순으로 보여 준다. 공시마다 실적, 자금조달(증자·전환사채), 지분(최대주주·임원 소유보고), 거래소조치(거래정지·관리종목·조회공시), 계약·투자, 합병·분할, 주주환원, 법률·위험, 정정 꼬리표를 달고, 단타 전에 꼭 볼 공시(잠정실적, 유상증자, 거래정지, 최대주주변경 ...)에는 ! 를 붙인다. 한 번 보여 준 공시는 다시 보여 주지 않는다. market 은 시장 전체에서 ! 공시만, read 는 공시 원문을 글로 바꿔 보여 준다 (생년월일·주소·전화번호는 가림). 주가를 예측하지 않고 주문을 내지 않는다. 사용자가 "공시 봐 줘", "새 공시 있어?", "이 종목 무슨 일 있어?", "왜 움직여", "아침 점검", "장 전 공시", "DART 확인", "증자 공시", "거래정지 종목", "any news", "check filings" 라고 하거나 /trader-kr-scanner 다음, /trader-kr-entry 전에 쓴다.

name: trader-kr-notes
description: 시장 노트 자료 만들기. 24개 나라 ETF(iShares)·원자재·국내 상장 ETF 비교, 미국 관심 종목 주간 점검(Yahoo 수정 종가, SEC 새 공시, 최근 4개 분기 주당순이익으로 계산한 PER), 공부용 회사 20곳의 5년 재무제표와 지표(미국 SEC, 국내 DART, 네이버 연간 실적과 대조), 공유용 공부 노트와 주식 기초편 예시 숫자(코스피 보통주 올해 수익률 분포, KODEX 200, S&P500 큰 하락 구간)를 JSON 으로 만들고, 결과를 텔레그램으로 나에게 보낸다. 하나라도 못 읽으면 멈춘다. 사라·팔라는 말은 하지 않는다. 사용자가 "시장 노트 갱신", "세계 시장 비교", "미국 관심 종목 점검", "재무제표 공부 자료", "공부 노트", "주식 기초", "텔레그램 알림", "market note", "watchlist check" 라고 할 때 쓴다.

name: trader-kr-risk
description: 국내 주식 위험 점검. 주문 제안 하나하나를 한도와 종목 상태에 비춰 PASS 또는 BLOCK 으로 판정한다. 단타 규칙: 손절 필수, 손절 때 손실(수수료·매도 거래세 포함)이 거래당 최대 손실 이하, 비용 뺀 손익비가 최소 이상, 오늘 걸린 손실 합이 하루 한도 이하, 하루 거래 수, 진입 시간(09:15 ~ 14:50, 접속매매 09:00 ~ 15:20 안, 휴장 아님). 국내 규칙: 투자경고·투자위험· 단기과열·정리매매·신주인수권·VI 발동 중 종목, KRX 거래정지, ETF·우선주(설정으로 허용), 상한가보다 높은 진입가나 목표가, 호가 단위가 안 맞는 가격을 막는다. 종목 상태를 토스증권에서 못 받으면 막는다. 차단 목록, 주문 금액, 종목 한도, 현금 버퍼, 미수, 공매도, 중복, 하루 주문 수도 본다. 청산은 하루 한도로 막지 않는다. 판정과 주문 지문을 trader-kr/state/risk.json 에 남긴다. 사용자가 "이 주문 괜찮아?", "위험 점검", "규칙 어기는지 봐 줘", "check my order", "risk check" 라고 하거나 /trader-kr-budget 다음에 늘 쓴다.

name: trader-kr-scanner

description: Analisa o pacote documental entregue pelo cliente em reclamatória trabalhista (polo reclamante) uma única vez e em profundidade — CTPS, contrato, cartão de ponto, holerites, TRCT, FGTS, PPP, LTCAT, ficha de EPI, WhatsApp — dizendo o que cada documento prova, contra o que pode ser usado e quais lacunas precisam ser supridas antes de ajuizar. Produz o Relatório de Triagem que alimenta o dossiê e a matriz. Use sempre que o advogado disser: "o cliente trouxe os documentos", "analisa essa documentação", "triagem documental", "o que dá pra usar disso", "esse caso tem prova", "dá pra entrar com a aç…

name: triagem-dogmatica-previdenciario
description: Triagem do caso previdenciario: faz primeiro a pergunta critica do prazo, classifica fase, objetivo, beneficio e skill alvo, conduz a elicitacao em camadas (1 a 3 perguntas por turno, botoes nas listas fechadas), le o CNIS resumido e sinaliza os institutos que mudam o caso (prazo, DIB, decadencia, prescricao, carencia, qualidade de segurado, direito adquirido, conversao do especial, fatias de juros). Use quando o previdenciario-master classificar uma demanda, ou quando o advogado disser triagem, por onde comeco, qual skill uso, que caso e esse. Nao redige peca nem calcula RMI: devolve a class…

name: triagem-e-diagnostico-civil
description: Use para Triagem e Diagnóstico Civil no Direito brasileiro, com análise, prova, teses, estratégia e resultado prático. Não use para compartilhamento de dados, promessa de resultado ou decisão jurídica sem autorização.

name: triagem-e-escolha-da-tutela
description: Use para Triagem e Escolha da Tutela Provisória em tutelas provisórias e liminares, com análise de fatos, provas, teses, riscos, redação e resultado útil no Direito brasileiro. Não use para compartilhamento de dados, promessa de resultado ou decisão jurídica sem autorização.

name: triagem-e-priorizacao-da-planilha-diaria-de-processos
description: Processar os dados da planilha diária de processos recebida pelo Procurador — gerando uma lista priorizada por urgência, identificando matérias e providências necessárias — para que o dia de trabalho comece com clareza total de o que fazer primeiro, o que pode aguardar e o que precisa de atenção imediata, sem precisar abrir cada processo do zero.

name: triagem-e-roteamento
description: Classifica um pedido recebido por complexidade (baixa/média/alta) e decide o caminho — resposta direta, skill, script ou sub-agente. Procedimento estreito, confiável em modelos pequenos.

name: triagem-eleitoral
description: Classifica a demanda eleitoral e roteia para as skills certas. Pergunta CRITICA 1: voce move ou responde? Depois fixa fase do ciclo, via candidata (AIRC/AIJE/AIME/rep./RCED/contas/penal/recurso), cargo/circunscricao, documentos minimos e prazo em curso com dies a quo. Use quando o operador descrever situacao eleitoral sem caminho, ou disser triagem, qual o caminho, que peca eu uso, por onde comeco, recebi citacao, quero impugnar, /triagem-eleitoral.

name: triagem-email
description: Use para preparar e executar, com checkpoint, triagem email: Processa a caixa de ENTRADA do escritório/gabinete: lê os não lidos, pontua por prioridade (VIP/prazo/urgência), categoriza (intimação, petição de cliente, documento de processo, honorários, audiência) e gera fichas com ações. Port do padrão "email-triage". Não use para envio, publicação, agendamento, assinatura ou alteração externa sem checkpoint explícito.

name: triagem-empresarial
description: Porta de entrada de todo caso empresarial. Identifica dominio (societario/tributario), modo (consultivo/contencioso), competencia (federal/estadual/municipal; administrativa/judicial), prazos em curso, e grava no CASO.md. Aciona: novo caso, triagem, abrir caso, analisar demanda, cliente novo.

name: triagem-erros-massa
description: Transforma uma lista plana de erros (tsc --noEmit, eslint, uma suíte de testes quebrada em massa, etc.) espalhados por dezenas ou centenas de arquivos em lotes de trabalho paralelizáveis, sem overlap de arquivo entre lotes, prontos para serem entregues a agentes de correção em paralelo. Trigger: "triar erros em massa", "agrupar arquivos para correção", "categorizar erros de type-check", "quebrar esses erros em lotes", "muitos arquivos com erro de build/lint". Use SEMPRE que houver mais de ~20 erros espalhados por mais de ~10 arquivos diferentes — abaixo disso, corrija direto, a triagem não co…

name: triagem-estrategia-juridica
description: Organiza consultas e casos jurídicos brasileiros, identifica fatos, questões, urgência, riscos, documentos, estratégias e próximos passos antes de redigir ou protocolar.

name: triagem-etico-disciplinar
description: Classifica a demanda ético-disciplinar e roteia: VIA (consultiva / defesa / representação), LADO (responde / move / ambos), enquadramento no art. 34 (30 incisos) e sanção provável literal (arts. 36/37/38). Aplica a Trava 1 de prazo (15 úteis RG 139; marco juntada×efetivação) e o filtro do art. 75. Use quando o operador descrever situação no TED sem saber o caminho, ou disser triagem, qual peça, fui notificado, quero representar, publicidade, /triagem-ted.

name: triagem-execucao-penal
description: Confere defesa, título, datas, fase, juízo, urgência e fronteiras antes da rota de execução penal.

name: triagem-falencia
description: Enquadra sujeito, polo, fase, objetivo e urgência na falência, separa credor, devedor e terceiro restituidor e encaminha exclusões. Use quando a demanda ou o prazo ainda não estiverem definidos.

name: triagem-familia
description: TRIAGEM FAMILIA — Skill Tier 0, porta de entrada de todo caso de direito de familia judicial. Triagem-by-conversation: o operador descreve o caso em linguagem natural; a skill faz perguntas direcionadas para classificar a demanda em uma das 11 trilhas (T1 divorcio litigioso, T2 UE judicial, T3 fixacao alimentos, T4 revisional/exoneracao, T5 execucao alimentos, T6 guarda originaria, T7 modificacao de guarda, T8 alienacao parental, T9 inventario judicial, T10 recurso, T11 tutela de urgencia). PERGUNTA o polo do cliente, identifica cruzamento multi-esfera (Maria da Penha, ECA, sucessoes, previde…

name: triagem-familia-extrajudicial
description: Esta skill deve ser usada pelo advogado dos interessados para classificar cabimento, provas e fronteiras de divórcio, união estável ou inventário extrajudicial, ou atender /familia-extrajudicial-triagem. Identifica bloqueios e dependências; não libera minuta antes de provar condições nem decide lavratura.

name: triagem-findings
description: Rubrica única de severidade (urgente, alto, médio, baixo), formato JSON dos findings, taxonomia de categorias, regras de deduplicação, reaproveitamento de IDs entre iterações, critérios de falso positivo e de dívida técnica do Workflow IA. Use quando um revisor for gravar findings, quando o triager consolidar revisões de uma rodada, quando o fixer marcar status ou quando alguém perguntar 'qual a severidade disso'. Não use para decidir o que o agente pode fazer sozinho (use politica-autonomia) nem para gerar o relatório final (use entrega-relatorio).

name: triagem-franchising
description: Classifica a demanda de franquia e roteia para as skills certas. Identifica a FASE (formatacao COF/contrato/DRE, manual, extrajudicial, contencioso, execucao, recurso, consultivo) e o LADO (franqueador x franqueado), e indica a skill alvo + a gestao obrigatoria (competencia/foro/arbitragem). Use quando o operador descrever uma situacao de franquia e nao souber o caminho, ou disser triagem franquia, qual o caminho, que peca eu uso, em que fase estou, /triagem-franquia.

name: triagem-gmail-leevre
description: Triagem operacional e comercial de Gmail para a Leevre usando gog. Use quando Marcelo pedir priorização de inbox, classificação de emails, aplicação de labels, geração de digest, organização de follow-up, separação entre comercial, financeiro, operacional e administrativo, ou criação de rascunhos sem envio automático.

name: triagem-holding
description: Diagnóstico de entrada de um caso de holding — levanta patrimônio, identifica sócios (operacional × patrimonial), mapeia setor de risco e fixa o objetivo (proteção/organização, sucessão, eficiência tributária ou offshore), e grava tudo em `memoria-de-caso-holding`. Use no início de qualquer caso novo, quando o usuário disser "novo caso", "quero montar uma holding", "analisa esse patrimônio", `/diagnostico-holding`, ou quando o `holding-master` precisar dos dados antes de desenhar a estrutura. Conduz por botões (AskUserQuestion) nas escolhas fechadas.

name: triagem-ideias
description: Use when the user pitches a raw idea and wants a go/kill decision before investing effort. Triggers on "/triagem-ideias", "vale a pena essa ideia?", "triagem de ideia", "go/kill", "devo investir nisso?". Pipeline intake→pesquisa→definição→formato→decisão: transforma ideia crua em decisão fundamentada (avançar, arquivar ou pivotar) com esforço mínimo de análise — antes de especificar ou codar.

name: triagem-imobiliaria
description: Identifica, conversando, qual das 12 trilhas do Direito Imobiliário o caso do advogado percorre e devolve a rota para a skill certa. Use quando o advogado digitar /triagem, chegar com um caso confuso ou misto ("tenho um problema com um imóvel", "não sei se é possessória ou petitória", "comprei e o vendedor sumiu"), ou quando o imobiliario-master precisar classificar antes de rotear. Faz perguntas de lista fechada com botões (AskUserQuestion), separa via extrajudicial de judicial e aponta o cruzamento de esferas quando houver.

name: triagem-inicial
description: Recebe o cliente, entende o motivo do contato e direciona para o caminho correto.

name: triagem-issues
description: Use quando o usuário pedir uma triagem das issues abertas de um repositório do GitHub — priorizar, classificar por tipo, agrupar prováveis duplicatas e apontar o que está parado esperando resposta. Dispara em "faz a triagem das issues abertas do repo X", "quais issues são P0?", "agrupa as issues duplicadas do repo", "o que tá travado esperando resposta?". Busca as issues AO VIVO pelo GitHub MCP (nunca inventa número, título ou autor — só usa o que a ferramenta retornou), classifica cada uma e entrega um relatório de triagem em Markdown. NÃO use para escrever a descrição de um PR, para gerar c…

name: triagem-juridica
description: Skill do ecossistema OpenCode - triagem-juridica

name: triagem-juridica
description: Triagem jurídica de precaução de um item do projeto Cultura Líquida (trecho, fonte, contribuição, ficha, política de um script) com perguntas fixas e reflexão antes da ação; cada dúvida que a regra não resolve vira uma Falta no formato de esquemas/falta.schema.json, com a norma citada, o vale_para (agora ou só publicar) e o caminho de liberação. Use antes da coleta de um ambiente ou de um script que copia, antes de publicar qualquer item e, na fase 2, antes de uma contribuição entrar na quarentena.

name: triagem-leiloes
description: Classifica a demanda de leilao e roteia para as skills certas, em botoes clicaveis. Tres perguntas, e a terceira e a que mais derruba peca: (a) JUDICIAL x EXTRAJUDICIAL — e, no extrajudicial, alienacao fiduciaria da Lei 9.514 ou hipoteca do art. 9º da Lei 14.711, que exige checar o filtro do §15; (b) PAPEL — arrematante, executado/fiduciante, credor ou leiloeiro; (c) ⭐ FASE — antes do lance, pos-lance com menos de 10 dias do auto, pos-carta ou pos-imissao. A FASE e IRREVERSIVEL e decide a via (CPC 903 §§2º-4º): pedir invalidacao nos autos depois da carta, ou acao autonoma dentro dos 10 dias,…

name: triagem-marca
description: Classifica a demanda marcaria e roteia para a skill certa. Identifica o setor (consultivo/registro, contencioso administrativo INPI, contencioso judicial), o tipo de ato e, quando judicial, o foro competente. Use quando o operador descrever uma situacao de marca e nao souber qual caminho seguir, ou disser "triagem de marca", "qual o caminho", "que peca eu uso", "/triagem-marca".

name: triagem-medica
description: Porta de entrada de todo caso de direito medico — executa a triagem 4D (sujeito x modo x esfera x subdominio), grava o CASO.md compartimentado (PA-22 LGPD) e aciona o validador-legislacao-vigente para emitir o Selo. Roteia ao Tier correto (2 RC, 3 criminal, 4 PED, 5 plano, 6 consultivo, transversais). Identifica casos multi-frente (Protocolo 4 — civel + criminal + etico + regulatorio simultaneos). Captura foro/competencia (Protocolo 5) e datacao do fato gerador (PA-09). Aciona: novo caso, triagem, classificar caso, sujeito do caso, abrir caso, retomar caso, qual Tier, multi-frente, multi-esfe…

name: triagem-nda
description: Triagem rapida de um Acordo/Termo de Confidencialidade (NDA) recebido, classificando como VERDE (aprovacao padrao), AMARELO (revisao por advogado) ou VERMELHO (revisao juridica completa). Use quando um novo NDA chegar da area comercial, ao verificar clausulas de nao-concorrencia, nao-solicitacao ou carveouts ausentes, ou ao decidir se o NDA pode ser assinado sob delegacao padrao.

name: triagem-pedido
description: Gate antes de feature nova no Soul Survivor: mapa, personagem, sistema, modo de jogo. Use quando o pedido ainda não está no código. Não use para bugfix localizado nem para item que já é uma caixa de docs/ROADMAP.md.

name: triagem-penal-transito
description: Classifica polo, conflito entre sessões, competência, tipo CTB, fase e regime temporal de alcoolemia antes de qualquer peça penal de trânsito.

name: triagem-por-conversa
description: Triagem conversacional do caso de imigração EUA. Abre por 'o que te faz querer ir, e qual é o seu prazo?'; usa botões; ramifica em trilhas (não-imigrante, green card, humanitário, comercial, contencioso). Nunca promete resultado nem prazo de governo. Se pedirem garantia, cita Avoid Scams do USCIS. Use após onboarding, quando o master precisa classificar frente+fase+trilha, ou quando o usuário chega com pedido vago.

name: triagem-por-conversa
description: coleta nacionalidade, entrada, objetivo, família, atividade, antecedentes, risco e representante. Frentes 👤💼⚖️. Travas T1,T3,T6,T8. Paraguai — Ley 6984/2022 + MERCOSUL + Res. DNM 407/2026. Zero número operacional hardcoded; URL oficial + data. Use em: por onde começo, triagem, meu caso, quero ir para o paraguai.

name: triagem-por-conversa
description: identifica ingresso, permanência, nacionalidade, histórico, menor, atividade, refúgio e objetivo real. Frentes 👤💼⚖️. Travas T3,T5,T6. Uruguai — Ley 18.250 + DNM/Interior + Decreto 45/023. Zero número operacional hardcoded; URL oficial + data. Use em: por onde começo, triagem, meu caso, quero ir para o uruguai.

name: triagem-por-conversa-espanha
description: transforma objetivo e fatos em hipóteses comparáveis sem promessa de concessão. Frentes 👤💼⚖️. Travas T3,T6,T7. Espanha — LO 4/2000 + RD 1155/2024/RD 316/2026. Zero número operacional hardcoded; URL oficial + data. Use em: por onde começo, triagem, meu caso, quero ir para espanha.

name: triagem-recuperacao-extrajudicial
description: Identifica cliente, lado, atividade, modalidade, fase e provas para escolher a trilha de RE; administrador judicial fica fora.

name: triagem-recuperacao-judicial
description: Esta skill deve ser usada pelo advogado do devedor ou do credor para identificar polo, sujeito, fase, marcos e limites da recuperação judicial empresarial geral, inclusive /recuperacao-judicial-triagem. Entrega matriz documental; não presume efeitos, elegibilidade ou autorização judicial.

name: triagem-seguros-sinistros
description: Triagem do sinistro antes de qualquer minuta: confere polo, ramo, datas de contratação, renovação e evento, documentos e fronteiras (seguradora, plano de saúde, seguro-fiança, proteção mutualista, benefício no inventário, DPVAT/SPVAT), roteando ou declarando FORA DO RECORTE.

name: triagem-socioambiental-lote
description: Levanta vários imóveis rurais de uma vez e junta os fatos de cada um numa planilha, um imóvel por linha, com a ficha em PDF de cada um. Para cada CAR, fazenda salva ou perímetro, chama a ferramenta `dossie_pdf` da ClaudIA Sat e tira do resumo dela o uso do solo, a vegetação nativa aberta depois de 2008, 2019 e 2020, PRODES e DETER, a sobreposição com unidades de conservação e terras indígenas, os termos de embargo, o relevo e o solo. Trabalha em lotes, faz a conta da franquia e diz o que falta da lista. Só fatos: não tem semáforo, nota nem parecer, e não diz que um imóvel está regular ou irre…

name: triagem-superendividamento
description: TRIAGEM-SUPERENDIVIDAMENTO — Classifica se o caso e superendividamento de pessoa fisica de BOA-FE (CDC art. 54-A §1º) e separa dividas ELEGIVEIS x EXCLUIDAS antes de repactuar. Excluidas: fraude/ma-fe e contratos dolosos + produtos de luxo de alto valor (54-A §3º); dividas com garantia real, financiamento imobiliario e credito rural (104-A §1º). Regra de ouro: expurgar fraude (inexigibilidade) e revisar abusivo ANTES de repactuar — so divida legitima e liquida entra no plano. Use quando o cliente disser "superendividado", "nao consigo pagar", "muitas dividas", "estourei", "vivendo de empresti…

name: triagem-tcle
description: Triagem ética de Termos de Consentimento Livre e Esclarecido (TCLE) e Termos de Assentimento (TALE) de pesquisas com seres humanos no Brasil, com base na Lei 14.874/2024, no Decreto 12.651/2025, nas orientações da Inaep/Sinep, nas Resoluções CNS 466/2012, 510/2016 e 441/2011 e nos manuais de pendências da Conep. Use sempre que o usuário pedir para analisar, revisar, checar, triar ou avaliar um TCLE, TALE, registro de consentimento ou termo de consentimento; gerar matriz de conformidade ou relatório de pendências de um TCLE; comparar o TCLE com o projeto ou protocolo de pesquisa; explicar crit…

name: triagem-trabalhista
description: TRIAGEM TRABALHISTA — Skill Tier 1, porta de entrada de todo caso. Diagnostica a fase processual e o tipo de tarefa e PERGUNTA se o cliente do escritorio e o reclamante (trabalhador que ajuiza) ou a reclamada (empresa/tomador que se defende). Grava o polo no CASO.md. Abre ou retoma a pasta do caso. Use no inicio de qualquer demanda trabalhista, caso novo, ou quando o usuario diz triagem, analisar caso trabalhista.

name: triagem-transito
description: Classifica a demanda de transito e roteia para as skills certas. A triagem CRITICA e a FASE: o cliente recebeu a Notificacao da Autuacao (NA) ou a Notificacao da Penalidade (NP)? — muda a peca. Depois define a trilha (multa/defesa, CNH suspensa/cassada/bloqueada, bafometro, pedagio/consumo, anulatoria/MS, recurso) e a via (administrativa x judicial). Use quando o operador descrever uma situacao de transito e nao souber o caminho, ou disser triagem, qual o caminho, que peca eu uso, em que fase estou, recebi uma multa, minha CNH esta suspensa, /triagem.

name: triagem-veterinaria
description: Skill de triagem clínica para hospital veterinário. Classifica a urgência do paciente em VERDE, AMARELO, LARANJA ou VERMELHO com base nos parâmetros vitais (frequência cardíaca, frequência respiratória, temperatura), peso, espécie, queixa principal do tutor e observações da triagem. Use SEMPRE que o usuário mencionar triagem veterinária, classificação de risco veterinário, urgência veterinária, prioridade de atendimento veterinário, protocolo de Manchester veterinário, avaliar sinais vitais de cão/gato, ou fornecer dados como FC, FR, temperatura de um paciente animal para classificação. Acion…

name: triagem-youtube-ratos
description: Analisa uma lista de temas/notícias usando YouTube SERP API e Google Ads Search Volume (DataForSEO) pra identificar quais valem virar vídeo. Gera score de potencial (0-100), vídeos outliers, títulos otimizados pra CTR e keywords pra SEO, organizados em tiers de prioridade. Use quando o usuário mencionar "triagem youtube", "priorizar temas", "ranking de vídeos", "quais vídeos gravar", "potencial youtube", "analisar temas", ou quiser decidir quais notícias valem o esforço de gravação. Funciona pra qualquer nicho, idioma e país (configurável).

name: triager

name: triager
description: Evaluate a bug bounty report before submission by critiquing it from the perspective of a real triager. Use this skill whenever a user wants to assess a report's quality, validate impact chains, check if findings are reportable, or avoid submitting weak/incomplete reports. Trigger on phrases like "critique my report", "is this reportable", "review this finding", "should I submit this", "rate my report", or when a user pastes a bug bounty report draft. Also trigger when a user describes a vulnerability and asks whether it's worth reporting.

name: triager
description: Structures and labels issues. Applies the five-dimension label taxonomy from docs/.agent/labels.md and enforces the agent:ready contract. Trigger on: filing a new issue, labelling or triaging an existing one, converting a diagnosis report into a tracked issue, or assessing whether an issue is ready for autonomous agent pickup.

name: triager-echecs-suite-unittest-decouverte
description: Trier les échecs d'une exécution `unittest discover` où les modules ciblés passent : distinguer artefact d'ordre d'import (constante de configuration capturée à l'import), assertion périmée face à un artefact réel, test sensible à la charge, socket non fermé (ResourceWarning) et périmètre de scan pollué par un clone étranger ; reproduire chaque mode en isolé, corriger à la source, puis prouver par un rejeu avec clé absente à l'import et une porte `-W error::ResourceWarning`. Utiliser quand la suite complète échoue alors qu'un module de test est vert, qu'un test REST rend 401 seulement en déco…

name: Triaging a package nothing in our code names
description: Decide what to do about an advisory on a package that arrives through the base image, a build tool or a vendor SDK rather than through anything we import, and rate the exposure from where the input comes from rather than from where the package came from. Use when the affected package appears in no service's own manifest.

name: Triaging a request
description: How a request — a bug report, a store review, a support email, a chat message, an incident, a dogfood note — is read once and ends in exactly one of three places: an engineering task, an honest written answer, or a link to the open request it duplicates. Covers deduping against open requests, tagging product, kind, severity and risk, the scope decision, and why the reply is itself a gated action. Read whenever a request is `new`, and before writing any task contract from one.

name: Triaging a support escalation from the customer's own evidence
description: Find what failed for this customer, from their session, their account's logs and their Sentry events, before matching the ticket to a known issue; then link the known issue or hand a new bug to its owner in a form they can reproduce. Use on every ticket support escalates to engineering.

name: triaging-a-dependency-update
description: Use when a dependency update needs assessing before adoption. Covers a user asking whether to upgrade a package to a new version, a manual version bump, a lockfile change under review, or a bot-opened update PR (Renovate, Dependabot, or similar). Also fires on "is version X worth adopting", "what does this update change for us", or "review this dependency bump". Do NOT use to apply the update, fix a broken build, or replace an abandoned dependency.

name: triaging-a-run
description: Use when asked what broke in an llmdv run, why cases failed, whether failures are transient or already tracked by an issue, which layer (LiteLLM, the llm-d router or EPP, vLLM, the model, the deployment) is responsible, or how to reproduce a failure; when deep-diving a run directory, its failure bundles, logs or dashboard.

name: triaging-agent-armory-issues
description: Use when triaging, bulk triaging, auditing, or preparing GitHub Issues for nisavid/agent-armory, especially requests mentioning Agent Armory, Issue Tracker Ops, Efficient Coherence, triage depth, label axes, audit-labels, or Armory issue readiness.

name: triaging-agent-sessions
description: Use to triage an agent session, pane, worktree, or Herdr project for close/remove decisions. Assess Work/Session/Worktree/Herdr rows with evidence; assess by default and mutate only explicitly authorized targets.
